verdict.rationale: The Core API covers a broad set of the registrar's core UI functions: availability checks for up to 50 names, registration, DNS records, inbound transfers, email forwarding, WHOIS privacy, and domain settings (locks, autorenew, contacts). It also offers renewals, TLD pricing, webhooks and reseller account creation, backed by SDKs and an MCP server. No source claims full UI parity, though. Some UI-side features, such as browsing expiring and premium domains, have no API equivalent in the evidence, and API tokens themselves are issued in the UI's Account Settings. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API evidence for the expiring/premium domain marketplace and account-level settings (billing, security, token management), and independent hands-on corroboration of coverage.
